question:
This aerial image was taken at an oblique angle, so building footprints look skewed and parallel streets appear to converge. Each candidate below is a 3x3 homography given row-major as nine numbers; applying it to the image is meant to restore a true orthographic (straight-down) view in which rectangular buildings become rectangular and parallel streets stay parallel. At most one candidate does this. Which one?
(A) [0.630335, 0.732938, -250.94, -0.503345, 1.77203, -101.29, -0.00123002, 0.000898442, 1]
(B) [0.375341, 0.175842, -5.64204, -0.481038, 1.01548, 32.8263, -0.00110043, 0.000278044, 1]
(C) [0.705461, -0.100841, 80.604, -0.115869, 0.496, 220.94, -0.000430655, -0.00026389, 1]
(D) None of the candidates produces a correct orthographic view.

Answer with only the correct option letter.

After applying candidate (C), the resulting image [img2] shows the same skewed perspective as the original image. The buildings and streets still appear distorted, and the transformation does not seem to have corrected the oblique angle. Therefore, candidate (C) is also incorrect.

Since candidates (A), (B), and (C) all fail to produce a correct orthographic view, the correct answer is (D).

<answer> D </answer>
